paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jordan gal a kumpipa tengteng, mual a omte, phaizang a omte, tuipi zatak dung teng a Lebanon pha a om tengteng, Hitte, Amorte, Kanaante, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste'n ana zak un,
heading: Gibeon Mite'n Joshua Akhem Uh

paite: Joshua leh Israelte pheikhai khat a dou tum in akikhawm uhi.
Himahleh Gibeon khomite'n Joshua in Jeriko khua leh Ai khua abawldan ana zak un, lepchiahpil in agamtang uhi.
Palai a kibawl in ip lui pipi, uain thawl lui pipi, asesa kithuap nemnum sabiltungte a pua in mi akisawl uhi.
Khedap lui thuap nennon abun ua, puan lui pipi asilh ua, anek ding tanghoute uh gaw gemgom, ap khetkhut ngen ahi.
Gilgal giahphual ah Joshua kiang ah ava hoh ua, akiang leh Israelte kiang ah, "Gamlapi a pan hong pai ka hi ua, huaiziak in tu in kou leh nou lemna thu khung ni,” achi uhi.
Israelte'n huai Hivte kiang ah, "Ka lak ua teng hi kha ni uchia; bangchi in nou toh lemna thu i khung thei dia?" achi uh.
Amau Joshua kiang ah, "Na sikhate ka hi uh," achi uhi. Joshua in akiang uah, "Kuate na hi ua? Koilam a pan hong pai na hi ua?" achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "TOUPA a Pathian min uh ka zak ziak un na sikhate gamlapi a pan hong pai ka hi uh. Aminthandan, Aigupta gam a athilhih tengteng,
Jordan lui gal a Amorte kumpipa nihte, Heshbon gam kumpipa Sihon, Bashan gam kumpipa Astaroth a om Og tung a athilhih tengteng ka na za uhi.
Ka upate uh leh ka gam ua tengte'n ka kiang uah, 'Lampi a nek ding tawi unla, amau va houpih un,' akiang uah, 'Na sikha ka hi uh. Nou toh kilem ni, na va chi ding uh," " chi in ahon sawl uhi.
“Hiai ka nek ding uh tanghoute na kiang a hong dia ka hong pawt ni ua ka inn ua kipan asa a ka hon puak uh ahi. Himahleh tu in en dih, agaw gemgom a a-ap khetkhutta hi.
Hiai thawl uain ka thunnate uh leng athak ahi. En dih, avang khin vekta hi. Hiai ka puante uh leh ka khedapte uh leng ka hong paina uh agamla mahmah a, aluigawpta hi," achi uhi.
Mite'n atawi uh nek-le-dawn dingte achiam ua, TOUPA dong in thu akan masa kei uhi.
Huchi in Joshua in amau toh kilemna abawl a, amaute hawi ding in amau toh thu akhungta hi. Omkhawm miliante leng akiang uah akichiam uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, akiang ua thu akhun ua kipan ni thum nung in, akhopite uh amau kiangnai a teng sam ahi uh, chih atheikheta uh.
Israel suante akipankhia ua, ani thum ni in akhopite uh ava tung uhi. Akhopite uh Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth leh Kiriath-jearim ahi.
Omkhawm heutute'n TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian min lou a akiang ua ana kichiam tak ziak un, Israel suante'n akhoih kei uh. Huchi in mipi omkhawm tengteng heutute tung ah aphun uhi.
Himahleh heutu tengteng in mipi omkhawm tengtengte kiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian min lou in akiang uah i na kichiamta ngal ua. Huaiziak in amaute i khoih uh siang lou ahi.
Hichibang in atung uah hih ni. I hinghawi mai ding uh. Huchi lou in zaw i tung uah thangpaihna ahong tung kha ding, akiang uah lah i na kichiam khinta ngal ua," achi uhi.
Heutute mah in akiang uah, "Hinghawi in om uhen. Himahleh omkhawm tengteng a dia sing po mite leh tui tawi mite hi uhen," achi uhi; heutute'n ana chiam khit tak sa bang un.
Joshua in amaute asamsak a, akiang uah, "Bangdia, gamlapi a pan hong pai ka hi uh, chi a hon khem na hi ua? Ka kiangnai a teng sam lah na hi ngal ua.
Huaiziak in tu in hamsiat na hi uh, na lak ua mi kuamah ka Pathian inn a dia sing pomi leh tui tawimi na hihna ua pan asuakta ngei kei ding uh," achi hi.

Amau Joshua adawng ua, "TOUPA na Pathian un asikha Mosi gam pumpi nou hon pe dia, agam luahmi tengteng na ma ua kipan ahihmang zel ding ahi, chih thu ana piak, na sikhate hon na hilhchian mahmah ua; huaiziak a noute ziak a ka hinna uh mansuah lau mahmah a, hichibang a na gamta ka hi uh.
Tu in ngai in, na khut a om ka hi ua; na ngaihtuahna a hoih leh dik a na theih bang in ka tung uah hih mai in," achi uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel suante a pan Joshua in hunkhia in, athatta kei uhi.
Huai ni in Joshua in aseh bang in omkhawmte leh TOUPA maitam a dia sing po mite leh tui tawi mite in asep a, tuni tan in hiaite in apang uhi.
